Sampling Unit Type.cell: Fraction of a CAI digestion — "Approximately 30% of the matrix cut", "equivalent to 24% fraction of the whole CAI"

Digestion Acid(s).cell: HF/HNO3 in 3:1 proportion with a few drops of HClO4, then -- after evaporation to dryness -- a 2:1 mixture of HCl:HNO3; dried down and dissolved in concentrated HNO3, diluted in 3 M HNO3 and centrifuged. The first HF/HNO3-HClO4 attack was missing from this cell before 2026-09-08.

Digestion Step.cell: 1: HF/HNO3 in 3:1 proportion with a few drops of HClO4, hot plate 160 deg C, 2 weeks | 2: evaporated to dryness and redissolved in a 2:1 mixture of HCl:HNO3, 1 week on a hot plate. "These steps were performed twice to ensure complete digestion" -- the PAIR is repeated, so under the 2026-09-08 grain rule the members are 2, not 4. The subsequent concentrated HNO3 and 3 M HNO3 are dry-down and uptake, not steps. Resolves the cell left open on 2026-09-08.

Digestion Duration.cell: 2 weeks for the HF-HNO3-HClO4 step and 1 week for the HCl-HNO3 step, the pair performed twice

Final Solution Matrix.cell: 15–25 ppb for the most abundant isotope

Chromatographic Separation Applied.cell: Yes — U/TEVA, TODGA, then two-step FPLC on Ln-Spec resin (70 cm x 1.6 mm, 1.4 ml of 25–50 µm resin, 94 steps, 188 ml, 16 h at 70 °C, 0.17 ml/min). Overall yields >95%

Isotope Dilution Spike.cell: N/A — no isotope dilution spike; mass bias handled by standard-sample bracketing or internal normalization

Instrument Model.cell: Neptune Plus "with the addition of an OnTool booster"
Instrument Model.value: Neptune Plus "with the addition of an OnTool booster"

ICP-MS Type.cell: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]
ICP-MS Type.value: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]

Target Species.cell: The rare earth elements — La, Ce, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Dy, Er, Yb and Y

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: N — the paper states "The cup configurations used for isotopic analyses of the REEs are provided in table S2" (p.9); that supplementary table is not in the archived PDF

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Mass-dependent REE isotopic fractionation relative to the OL-REE standards, in delta notation

value.member: Mass-dependent REE isotopic fractionation relative to the OL-REE standards

Collector Configuration.cell: Static mode for most REEs; a subconfiguration for Dy and Yb to monitor isobaric interferences

Number of Cycles per Block.cell: 40 cycles in the main configuration; the subconfiguration measured twice

Analysis Sequence.cell: Standard-sample bracketing — "On average, LREEs were measured nine times bracketed by OL-REE isotope standard spaced apart by 300-s rinsing time"

Internal Standard Element.cell: N/A — mass bias corrected by standard-sample bracketing, internal normalization or a double spike rather than by an added internal standard element

Internal Standard Concentration.cell: N/A — no added internal standard element

Mass Bias Correction Strategy.cell: Standard-sample bracketing against OL-REE standards — "SSB is advantageous over the double-spike approach because one can distinguish mass-dependent fractionation from isotopic anomalies"

Calibration Strategy per Target Species.cell: One OL-REE series standard per REE, with separate cup configurations for Dy and Yb

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: Yes — Er on Dy, and neighbouring-element isotopes generally

Interference Correction Method.cell: Subconfiguration scaling — 166Er measured only in the subconfiguration, 163Dy in both; the 166Er/163Dy ratio is scaled onto the main configuration and multiplied by 162Er/166Er and 164Er/166Er to subtract the interferences

Uncertainty Level.cell: Not stated in the section read
Uncertainty Level.value: Not stated in the section read

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially — "On average, LREEs were measured nine times"; replicate matrix cuts were measured but "are not used, however, for data interpretation to avoid unnecessary influence of stable isotopic fractionation potentially induced by Mo chemistry" — an explicit exclusion, on chemical rather than statistical grounds

Combination Method.cell: all: per sample, over 1 to 12 (typically 5) standard-sample-standard bracketings; the mean of seven CAIs is also shown — 'The reported φE values were calculated based on 1 to 12 (typically 5) STD-SMP-STD bracketings'; Fig. 1 'The dashed line is the average isotopic fractionation' of the seven CAIs

value.value: per sample, over 1 to 12 (typically 5) standard-sample-standard bracketings

Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.cell: Every sample, spaced by 300 s rinsing
Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.value: Every sample, spaced by 300 s rinsing

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: Assessed in a dedicated "Assessment of data accuracy" section, using replicate matrix cuts and a processed geostandard
